summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by VersaBank furnishing its interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for Q2 2026, along with dividend declarations and CEO/CFO certifications. It includes a routine reference to a prior disposal of an 11% investment in Stablecorp for $1,035,000, generating a small gain, but this is a historical disclosure, not a current special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special event. As a Canadian foreign private issuer's routine quarterly report, it is a standard current report on Form 6-K with no special-situation classification.
